data: What is the lowest value of the orange line in the middle plot?

The middle plot shows the validation error rate curves for finetuning the classifier with 'Full' and ULMFiT on TREC-6. The orange line represents the ULMFiT curve. To find the lowest value of the orange line, I need to look at its position across all training epochs. The orange line appears to reach its lowest point near the beginning of the plot, around the 5% mark on the y-axis. Therefore, the lowest value of the orange line in the middle plot is approximately 5%.
